$comment: Empirical character measurements and derived token sizing for the pilot corpus (34 accepted pairs) and the tr-* training corpus (210 pairs across 30 families x 7 frameworks). Figures are derived estimates (characters/4), not tokenizer-measured. Primary headline sizing is app_sources only, summing both sides of each pair (serialized pair-volume estimate).

pilot.baseline_definition: deterministic repair of the project by our own Modern Web Guidance rule specifications; no model and no teacher in the loop
